caption: The drawing features a blue pitcher with a handle on the left side and a wavy spout at the top. The body of the pitcher is decorated with a pattern of raised, rounded bumps or nodes covering its entire surface. The color of the pitcher varies in shades of blue, with darker hues at the base and lighter tones towards the top, and some highlights indicating reflections. To the right of the pitcher, there is a rectangular inset containing a simple black line drawing of the pitcher’s profile, including the handle and spout, against a white background. This inset profile is outlined in black and shows part of the bumpy texture indicated by small red and black marks along the base. The background of the drawing is an off-white or beige color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Blue Hobnail Pitcher
